entries.description: Name of an on/off option in the watch face customization editor. When on, the always-on (ambient) screen shows a simple clock and readings instead of the user's design. Must be very short: it is drawn on one line at the top of a round watch screen.

entries.ui_location: Watch > watch face editor > option (screen reader)
entries.description: Full spoken description of the 'Simple always-on' option, read by the screen reader instead of the short title. No length limit; a full sentence.
